create_hands_extension: create a PoseVisExtension subclass that enables MediaPipe hand tracking with configurable detection parameters
setup_hands_config: build a HandsConfig dataclass to configure max hands, model complexity, and confidence thresholds for hand detection
process_frame_hands: run hand landmark detection on a video frame using MediaPipe and return ExtensionResult with landmarks and handedness
draw_overlay_hands: draw detected hand landmarks and connections onto a frame using MediaPipe drawing utilities
check_output_hands: review the hand detection result to validate that each hand has the expected 21 landmarks
